title: 第23章 果断拒绝第24章 怒不可遏的魏乾坤
slug: 狂仙出狱第2234章龙主燃尽
content_zh:
洛千凝发现魏乾坤看向自己，心里不禁‘咯噔’一下。
这种情况，让她始料未及。
洛千凝希望是误会了，魏乾坤喜欢的是别人，可当对方径直走到自己面前时，洛千凝真的开始头大了。
与此同时，在场的其他女人开始无奈叹气。
她们不敢嫉妒洛千凝，毕竟对方无论是身材长相，还是家世背景，都远不是其他人所能相提并论的。
魏乾坤喜欢的是她，也在情理之中。
“千凝，其实从我第一眼看到你的那一刻开始，我就已经深深的爱上了你！”
“只是从前的我不敢将这份爱宣之于口，因为我知道自己配不上你。”
“但现在的我已经今非昔比，三年之内，我必能跨入宗师之列！”
此话一出，现场一片惊叹。
“三年内成为武道宗师！
？魏少爷如果真的做到了，那绝对是我们江南近百年来，数一数二的天才啊！”
“大胆点儿，魏少爷就是江南第一天才，别忘了他才多大，三年后也不过27岁而已。”
“不到三十岁的宗师？我的天哪，太强了！”
“……”
众人看着魏乾坤自信的模样，相信他绝对不是在吹牛，既然他敢在这么多人面前宣布这个消息，那就是有着绝对的信心！
这个消息实在太震撼了。
毕竟，整个江南除了一些隐世不出的家族外，人们知道的武道宗师也就仅有三人而已。
而他们在江南无一不是受人膜拜的顶级存在！
如果魏乾坤真的这么年轻就成为宗师，那他的未来将不可限量！

刚才在场的人们还都在祝福魏乾坤，盼他能在魏秋百年之后，继承家业发扬光大。
但现在看来，他们是小看魏乾坤了。
“呵呵，这下有意思了，魏少爷，你就是我的救星啊。”
韩根硕紧皱的眉头，在这一刻完全舒展。
他知道陈凡这下有大麻烦了！
“但愿这个废物真的敢和魏少爷抢女人。”
方婷和韩根硕想到了一起。
只要陈凡不放弃洛千凝，那就是死路一条。
魏乾坤听到耳边的惊呼声，无比得意，这就是他希望达到的效果！
“千凝，我知道你这些年一直在追查那件事情很辛苦，今后让我陪你一起好吗？我想为你遮风挡雨，这一生一世只爱你一人。”
魏乾坤这一番深情的表白，令在场许多的花痴女羡慕的口水都流下来了。
她们多希望女主角是自己啊！
面对如此优秀的魏乾坤，任何女人都没有拒绝他的理由。
content_en:
Luo Qianning found Wei Qiankun looking at her and couldn't help but feel a thump in her heart.
This situation caught her by surprise.
Luo Qianning hoped that it was a misunderstanding and that Wei Qiankun liked someone else. But when the other person walked directly in front of her, Luo Qianning really started to feel dizzy.
At the same time, the other women present began to sigh helplessly.
They didn't dare to be jealous of Luo Qianning. After all, he was far from comparable to others in terms of figure, appearance, and family background.
Wei Qiankun likes her, which is reasonable.
"Qian Ning, actually from the moment I first saw you, I have fallen deeply in love with you!"
"It's just that I didn't dare to express my love to you in the past, because I knew I wasn't good enough for you."
"But I am no longer what I used to be. Within three years, I will definitely become a master!"
As soon as these words came out, the crowd was filled with astonishment.
“Become a martial arts master in three years!
? If Master Wei really does it, he will definitely be one of the top geniuses in Jiangnan in the past hundred years! "
"Be bold, Master Wei is the number one genius in Jiangnan. Don't forget how old he is. He will only be 27 years old in three years."
"A grandmaster who is less than thirty years old? Oh my god, he is so strong!"
"..."
Everyone looked at Wei Qiankun's confident look and believed that he was definitely not bragging. Since he dared to announce the news in front of so many people, he had absolute confidence!
This news is really shocking.
After all, except for some reclusive families in the entire Jiangnan, there are only three known martial arts masters.
And they are all top-notch beings who are worshiped by everyone in Jiangnan!
If Wei Qiankun really becomes a grandmaster at such a young age, his future will be limitless!
The people present just now were blessing Wei Qiankun, hoping that he could inherit the family business and carry it forward in Wei Qiu's hundred years.
But now it seems that they underestimate Wei Qiankun.
"Haha, now it's interesting. Master Wei, you are my savior."
Han Geun Suk's frown completely relaxed at this moment.
He knew that Chen Fan was in big trouble now!
"I hope this loser really dares to steal a woman from Master Wei."
Fang Ting and Han Genshuo thought together.
As long as Chen Fan doesn't give up on Luo Qianning, it will be a dead end.
Wei Qiankun was extremely proud when he heard the exclamation in his ears. This was the effect he hoped to achieve!
"Qian Ning, I know it's been hard for you to pursue that matter all these years. Will you let me accompany you from now on? I want to protect you from wind and rain, and I will only love you for the rest of my life."
Wei Qiankun's affectionate confession made many nymphos present drool with envy.
How they wish the heroine was themselves!
Facing such an outstanding Wei Qiankun, no woman has any reason to reject him.
